text:
emma: @channel Rolling out Gen API v3 GA now — unified streaming + tool-calls + new model variants. New defaults: redwood-comet-1 (balanced), mosaic-slim-quant (cost-saver). No auth changes. Deprecation: legacy /v2 gen endpoints retired in 120 days. :tada:

olivia: Huge congrats team! Quick note: console banners + deprecation emails go out tomorrow. Migration guide will include examples for streaming and tool-call webhooks.

kevin: Rollout plan: canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~6h with gate checks at each step. Autoscale profiles tuned for the new models. Watch GPU preemptions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for gen-pool-beta at 1851234630

anya: SRE checklist: dashboards added for gen.latency.{p50,p95}, streaming.conn_errors, toolcall.5xx_rate. New alerts: p95 > 550ms OR toolcall.5xx_rate > 0.5% -> page. Synthetic stream tests every 45s.

marta: Docs PR up: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/v3-unified (pr #505). Includes migration snippets and example webhook payloads.

sam: Legal update: tool-call integrations require explicit external-scope consent in console. We'll add a short schema and an opt-in flow in the migration docs.

kevin: No header changes; use existing API key. Optional params: `model_variant`, `streaming:true`, `allow_tool_calls:true`. Quick curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/gen
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-comet-1","streaming":true,"input":"Summarize the meeting notes","allow_tool_calls":true}'
```

olivia: Canary testers use header `X-Canary-Key` — ping me for keys. Fallback policy: teams can opt into automatic low-cost fallback to mosaic-slim-quant if p95 breaches SLA.

anya: Rollback path: flip routing flag or route traffic back to v2 group. Full rollback target < 30m. Oncall will monitor first 8h closely.

emma: Thanks everyone — marketing will schedule the public GA post after monitoring window. If you spot anomalies, ping #eng-oncall and tag @anya. Celebrate! :rocket:
